welcome: Welcome to Family Gest. You can add an event, shopping items, a dish, an absence, a presence or a guest, or ask who is home for a meal, the pending tasks and the planned meals. What would you like to do?
help: For example, you can say: add dentist on Tuesday at 3 PM. Buy milk and eggs. Put lasagne on Thursday for dinner. Paul will be away tomorrow for lunch. Granny is coming for dinner on Saturday. You can also ask: who is home tonight? What are the pending tasks? What are we eating this week? What would you like to do?
